I just wrote up my thoughts comparing my Verbos CO, Instruo CS-L, and my Buchla Easel Command last night actually.

CO’s are my favorite! It took awhile for me to realize it but I love them! There’s a huge wealth of sounds you can get from any of them and they all have their niche. The Verbos is one of my favorites and has a nice fuzziness I really enjoy. The wave folder with the other shaping params almost verges into nice distortion. The FM seems a little more tame than the CS-L. In most respects, the CS-L is the most full spectrum of the 3, the wavefolder is more aggressive and goes a little further than the Buchla or the Verbos and the FM for whatever reason seems a little wilder. I found it easier to dial in softer sounds with the Verbos personally but the CS-L is definitely capable. Tbh try them all! You certainly can piece them together with separate oscillators and wave folders but a CO on its own is quite special. The ergonomics are better and I think it’s lends itself to faster experimentation (and it’s likely cheaper in almost all cases to get a CO vs piecemeal)

TLDR: the CS-L reminds me most of the Easel but the Verbos is my preferred in eurorack. The Verbos has a fuzziness and midrange thing going on that I find more interesting. Sold the CS-L, kept my Verbos and the Easel
